summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests NP-101 in adults with solid tumors. NP-101 is given by mouth, and how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety and preliminary effectiveness.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa NP-101 en adultos con tumores sólidos. NP-101 se administra por vía oral, y el registro no indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with advanced or metastatic solid tumor that returned or worsened after standard treatment, or with no standard treatment available.
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 for dose expansion; evaluable or measurable disease for dose escalation.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Adequate blood, liver, kidney, and heart function, and willing to give consent.
Willing to undergo required tumor biopsy and blood collections.
not_for: Allergic reaction to compounds similar to the study drug.
Unresolved toxicities from prior therapy above the stated grade limits.
Unable to swallow and keep down oral medication, or GI disease affecting absorption.
Brain or leptomeningeal metastases, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
